review:
A progressive prize sits above each of the five reels, with the 5,000x top prize above reel three. Lightning symbols on reels 1–2 or 4–5 add 0.5x to the prize above them and can randomly trigger the Bonus Wheel, which pays one of them.

A base-game multiplier grows by 0.5x every time four scatters land and carries into free spins (from five scatters). Before the bonus, scatters reveal extra spins or multiplier boosts. 5,000x max, 96.52% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
